meta.source: IPTrust brand API (apuch.art/api/brands/vanahom.json, guide VANAHOM/vanahom_design.md v0.4) + 凡纳弘途 deck slim-VANAHOM v0.4 (sampled values marked 'deck')

tokens.name: hongtu-red
tokens.usage: 弘途红 Hongtu Red, the primary. Wordmark, key headings, short rules, table header cells and the one call to action. At most 8% of any view. 6.68:1 on paper, so headings and large labels may be red; running text never is. White text on it reads 6.68:1.

tokens.name: hongtu-red-deep
tokens.usage: Secondary deep red. Red text on paper (9.0:1) and on red-wash (7.57:1): inline emphasis, card roles, case-study titles. Button pressed state.

tokens.name: red-wash
tokens.usage: Faint red wash (deck). Row-header cells in service matrices, active and focus fills. Text on it: ink-soft or hongtu-red-deep.

tokens.name: cangling-grey
tokens.usage: 苍灵灰 Cangling Grey, the accent. Hairlines, dividers, eyebrows and captions. Only 2.27:1 on paper: the source sets eyebrows in it; keep those 12px uppercase labels decorative and never put information only there. Use grey-deep for readable grey text.

tokens.name: grey-deep
tokens.usage: Muted text: leads, captions, source notes (出处), table footnotes. 4.75:1 on paper; on mist it drops to 4.33:1, so keep it on paper for body sizes.

tokens.name: logo-grey
tokens.usage: Ink of the grey wordmark (from the logo artwork). Wordmark on hongtu-red banners (4.73:1) and quiet sign-offs. Not for text.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headings and the ink wordmark on paper (16.96:1), mist and sand.

tokens.name: ink-soft
tokens.usage: Body copy on paper (12.33:1), mist (11.24:1), cell (11.61:1) and red-wash (10.38:1).

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: The base ground. White does the work: at least 40% of each view stays empty. Also text on hongtu-red and clay.

tokens.name: mist
tokens.usage: Quiet section ground behind content blocks.

tokens.name: cell
tokens.usage: Content cells of service matrices and comparison tables (deck).

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: 1px hairlines: table rules, card outlines, column dividers. Structure comes from hairlines and space, never shadows.

tokens.name: sanctem-clay
tokens.usage: SANCTEM only. Quality cards (静 气 光 流) with paper text (5.22:1). Never on a VANAHOM corporate surface, never in the same block as hongtu-red.

tokens.name: sanctem-clay-soft
tokens.usage: SANCTEM only. Secondary clay fills and table header cells; large text only.

tokens.name: sanctem-sand
tokens.usage: SANCTEM only. Page and panel ground; ink on it reads 14.17:1.

tokens.name: sanctem-sand-deep
tokens.usage: SANCTEM only (deck). Panel headers, the corner square, bullet discs. Ink on it 11.16:1.

tokens.name: sanctem-tier-community
tokens.usage: SANCTEM brand matrix (deck): 随行 · 社区级 Stand-Alone card. Ink text (11.46:1).

tokens.name: sanctem-tier-origin
tokens.usage: SANCTEM brand matrix (deck): 本源 · 城市级 Origin card. Ink text (10.33:1).

tokens.name: sanctem-tier-essence
tokens.usage: SANCTEM brand matrix (deck): 臻选 · 度假区级 Essence card. Ink text (5.93:1); the deck's white text on it is only 2.86:1, so don't copy that.

tokens.name: sanctem-tier-reserve
tokens.usage: SANCTEM brand matrix (deck): 奢享 · 目的地级 Reserve card. Paper text (8.31:1).

families.sans: Manrope, "Noto Sans SC", "PingFang SC", system-ui, sans-serif

styles.name: mega
styles.usage: clamp(56px, 11vw, 150px). One per page at most: hero maxim or the name.

styles.name: lead
styles.usage: clamp(17px, 1.6vw, 21px), grey-deep, text-wrap: pretty. Intro paragraph and the English line under a maxim.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: 共建未来，是同心协力之事，亦是你我他应尽之责。
styles.usage: Running text in ink-soft. Sentence case.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Emphasis inside body; colour stays ink unless it is a named service (then hongtu-red-deep).

styles.name: label
styles.usage: UI labels, buttons, table cells, roles.

styles.name: small
styles.sample: *上述服务内容仅供参考，实际内容以项目服务建议书为准。

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: The only uppercase style. Cangling grey with a short hongtu-red rule before it.

styles.name: micro
styles.usage: Classical source lines and legal footers, grey-deep.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gaps.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inline gaps, eyebrow rule gap.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Table cell vertical padding; photo offset block of CaseStudy.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding, gap between table cells.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between title and body; grid gutters.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Gap between blocks in a section.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Minimum section rhythm (mobile); matches the lower bound of the section clamp.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Page side margins on wide screens (suggested; the guideline sets none). BioBanner side padding.

tokens.name: space-32
tokens.usage: Large separations, hero clearance.

tokens.name: section
tokens.usage: Section rhythm maximum: clamp(64px, 10vw, 140px).

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Default for everything: blocks, photos, tables, cards.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: The most a control may round: buttons, inputs, chips. Nothing rounder.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: All rules and outlines, in line or cangling-grey.

tokens.name: rule-accent
tokens.usage: The short hongtu-red underline of SectionTitle and the eyebrow rule.

tokens.name: motion-base
tokens.usage: Fades with a small (8px) rise, ease-out. Nothing loops; honour prefers-reduced-motion.
